Contact sheet
Reproduce
From the repository root run node examples/visual-instrument/check.cjs /tmp/v13-captures with locally installed Chrome and puppeteer-core. See the example README for setup. The check starts a fresh loopback server on an ephemeral port, drives the panel and asserts the results.
